title: Demo QA never reads a run of years (a timeline's "2024.\n2026", "2019 - 2024", "© 2024 2025") as a phone number, so collected-used no longer fails a demo with COLLECTED_UNSOURCED for one; real phones are still read
steps: S1: run apps/tracy-host/test/demo-qa.test.mjs: factsIn on runs of years joined by a dot, a hyphen, a slash, a space or a line break, and on real phones (720) 555-0160, +971 4 123 4567, 04 123 4567, +84 90 123 45 67.
S2: same file: checkCollectedUsed on a page with the collected phone and a timeline "Opened 2024.\n2026 a second floor".
expect: S1: no phone is read from any run of years; a line break ends a phone; each real phone is read with its digits.
evidence: Dev 24/10/2026: a real demo failed collected-used with COLLECTED_UNSOURCED phone '2024.\n2026' read from a timeline; the old PHONE regex ran across the line break and the guard skipped only a single year or a date.
fence: A phone's groups sit on one line; a match made only of 19xx/20xx years is no phone; a number that merely starts like a year ("2024 5678 9") is still one

tests: facts: a run of years is no phone, and a phone never runs across a line break
collected-used: a timeline of years beside the collected phone is no unsourced phone
